description: Videomagic turns topics discussed in ChatGPT, pasted briefs, public URLs, and attached files into videos. ChatGPT authors a video description from the current context; the app does not request or transmit raw conversation history. Users can review a pending draft, confirm rendering, adjust video settings, track progress, and play completed media without leaving ChatGPT.
